review_metadata.scope: GridDB test Q021-Q200; all 114 order_sensitive items and all 18 top-k items
review_metadata.blindness: Reviewed only question text, gold SQL, declared order_sensitive metadata, and SQLite schema constraints. No model predictions, model outputs, semantic diagnostic outcomes, or diagnostic result tables were read.
review_metadata.claim_boundary: Agent technical audit of ordering metadata and tie handling; not a human domain annotation or evidence of linguistic correctness.

decision_rules.TOTAL_ORDER_VALID: Natural language makes order material and gold supplies a semantically declared total order without unresolved cutoff ties.
decision_rules.TIE_AMBIGUOUS_HOLD: Rank/time selection is material, but ties can alter order/cutoff or SQL uses an undeclared tie policy.
decision_rules.ORDER_METADATA_INCONSISTENT: Natural language does not require order, yet order_sensitive=true treats equivalent permutations as different.
decision_rules.technical_total_order_note: Technical determinism and semantic justification are separate; a primary/group key can close SQL ties without authorizing order-sensitive grading.

items.question: Which assets are offline?

items.basis: The question requests a set/list but states no sorting, ranking, chronology, or tie rule. Order-sensitive grading can reject equivalent permutations. The gold ORDER BY is not guaranteed total because its final key has no declared UNIQUE constraint.

items.question: Which asset type has the most alarmed sensor readings?
items.gold_sql: SELECT t.type_name, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM sensor_readings s JOIN assets a ON s.asset_id = a.asset_id JOIN asset_types t ON a.asset_type_id = t.asset_type_id WHERE s.alarm_flag = 1 GROUP BY t.type_name ORDER BY alarm_count DESC, t.type_name LIMIT 1;
items.basis: “most” makes rank material. COUNT ties are possible; type_name makes SQL deterministic but silently chooses an undeclared lexical winner.
items.suggested_secondary_key: t.type_name ASC (already present); state the lexical tie policy in the question, or return all co-winners
